feeds.title: CelloBello Blog
feeds.description: CelloBello is a groundbreaking platform dedicated to cello pedagogy and innovative musical exchange. It is everything about the cello. From cello lessons, to music events and competitions, to articles and videos from the world's top cellists.

feeds.title: Cello with Peter Williams Blog
feeds.description: Hi I'm I am Peter Williams, certified Suzuki Cello Instructor and cello teacher to children for over 20 years. Here you'll find more information on cello lessons, the Suzuki method and my teaching approach, along with upcoming festivals, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Absolutt cello
feeds.description: News for all members in Absolute Cello.

feeds.title: New Directions Cello Festival and New Directions Cello Association Blog
feeds.description: New Directions Cello Festival and New Directions Cello Association is a not for profit organization that has created a network for the growing field of alternative and non-classical cello. The goals of the NDCA&F are to encourage interaction among non-classical cellists, and to promote awareness among all cellists and the musically oriented public about the contributions that cellists are making in many styles of contemporary music.

feeds.title: Paul Perley Blog
feeds.description: Paul Perley Cellos offers fine cellos and stringed instruments. They specialize in the restoration, repair, and sale of cellos, basses and violins.

feeds.title: Nan Kemberling Blog
feeds.description: Nan Kemberling is a cellist, cello teacher, and coach in Atlanta, GA. She is available for performances, private lessons and masterclasses, and clinics on performance anxiety and ergonomic cello technique. She lives and breathes cello everyday, and she want to share thoughts about it with you.

feeds.title: Bryan Charles Wilson Blog
feeds.description: Bryan Wilson is a cellist, composer, educator, and author. He offers a uniquely modern perspective on the cello that is sure to inspire. He introduces students to the innovative and exciting roles that the cello can play in contemporary music.

feeds.title: London Cello Society
feeds.description: The London Cello Society promotes the art of cello playing, preserving its great traditions while encouraging its continuing development.

feeds.title: Mid-Life Cello
feeds.description: If I knew then what I know now I never would have done it and I'd have missed out on so much.

feeds.title: I'm Just Telling You What My Cello Prof Tells Me
feeds.description: Cello performance major '21, they/them/theirs, here to offer some advice about music college and cello playing.

feeds.title: Cello Discovery Blog
feeds.description: Cello Discovery is a comprehensive, step-by-step approach to learning the cello. The cello blog for the beginning online cello student. Tips and tricks to help you succeed in learning the cello as an adult online learner.

feeds.title: JJCello
feeds.description: Hi I'm Joan Jeanrenaud. I compose, improvise and arrange music, as well as research, produce and present multi-media performance arts. Follow the blog to find more on cello by Joan Jeanrenaud.
